Feature.Description: Provides access to the device user manual. The ManualDocument property returns the raw PDF bytes for display in a viewer, while ManualText returns the full extracted text content for LLM search and chat context.

Property.Description: The device user manual as a PDF binary. Clients can display this in an embedded PDF viewer or offer it as a download.
The full text content extracted from the device user manual. Intended for LLM/chat context so the assistant can answer questions about device operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
